description: Expected risk flags for the sample contracts. Each expected flag names the section where the risk is planted and a short phrase that appears verbatim in that section, so an eval can check both that the flag was raised and that the right clause was cited. 'forbidden_flags' are risks that are NOT present; raising them counts as a false positive.

flag_taxonomy.unlimited_liability: Uncapped or grossly asymmetric liability or indemnity exposure for one party.
flag_taxonomy.auto_renewal: Term renews automatically unless notice is given, especially with long renewal periods, narrow notice windows, or built-in increases.
flag_taxonomy.one_sided_termination: One party may terminate freely while the other cannot, or can only under onerous conditions.
flag_taxonomy.ip_assignment: Broad assignment of intellectual property or work product to the counterparty, including pre-existing or independently created material.

expected_flags.evidence: whether or not derived from Confidential Information
expected_flags.notes: Assigns everything Recipient creates during the Purpose, including improvements to Recipient's own pre-existing tools, and waives moral rights.

expected_flags.evidence: Discloser may terminate this Agreement at any time, for any reason or no reason
expected_flags.notes: Recipient can only terminate for uncured material breach after 90 days and then only with Discloser's consent.
Recipient indemnifies for all loss including consequential and punitive damages with no cap; Discloser's own liability is capped at GBP 100.

expected_flags.evidence: automatically renew for a further term of twenty-four (24) months
expected_flags.notes: 12-month initial term rolls into 24-month renewals, notice must land exactly 180 days before expiry or is void, and rent rises 8% each renewal.

expected_flags.evidence: There is no cap on Tenant's liability under this Lease
expected_flags.notes: Tenant indemnifies for all loss including other tenants' lost rent and consequential loss, even where caused by Landlord's own negligence.

expected_flags.evidence: Landlord may terminate this Lease at any time on thirty (30) days' written notice, with or without cause
expected_flags.notes: Tenant has no early termination right at all and receives no compensation if Landlord terminates.

samples.notes: Control sample. Balanced mutual NDA: no assignment, mutual 30-day termination, fixed term with no auto-renewal, liability capped at EUR 250,000 with only the legally required carve-outs. Any of the four flags here is a false positive.
